# hoofoot.com

> > A multi-domain content aggregator covering Norwegian home textiles retail (Kid), internet meme culture (Know Your Meme), and TV entertainment guides (TV Guide).

This site appears to aggregate content from three distinct domains: Kid Interiør (Norway's largest textile and interior retailer), Know Your Meme (viral internet culture documentation), and TV Guide (streaming and broadcast television schedules). The content spans e-commerce, entertainment news, and cultural commentary.

## Key Topics

- Kid Interiør
- Know Your Meme
- TV Guide
- Norwegian home textiles
- Streaming services (Netflix, Hulu, Peacock)
- TikTok viral trends
- Meme culture
- TV schedules and listings
- Bedding and home decor
- Entertainment recommendations
- Instagram Reels
- Viral catchphrases
- Local broadcast listings
- Movie recommendations
- Celebrity news

## TV & Streaming Guides

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage with streaming recommendations & reviews for Netflix, Hulu, HBO
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule listings by provider for today's shows & programs
- [The 61 Best Movies on Netflix Right Now (March 2026) - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): Curated list: 61 best Netflix movies feat. Jurassic World Rebirth
- [The 43 Best TV Shows on Hulu Right Now (March 2026) - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/best-shows-on-hulu): 43 best Hulu shows including Paradise S2 & Scrubs revival
- [The 16 Best Movies to Watch on Peacock Right Now (March 2026) - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-peacock): 16 best Peacock movies feat. Oscar nominees Hamnet & Bugonia
- [New Amazon Prime Video TV Shows and Movies in March 2026 - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/new-on-amazon-prime-video): March 2026 Prime Video releases: Scarpetta, Young Sherlock, Deadloch
- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule: MLB, NBA, NHL, soccer & college games

## Kid Interiør - Home Textiles & Decor

- [Tekstil og interiør til hjemmet](https://kid.no): Homepage for Kid Interiør, Nordic's largest textile/interior retailer
- [Sengetøy- Stort utvalg av sengesett i god kvalitet - Kid](https://kid.no/soverom/sengetoy): Bedding category with cotton, linen, percale & satin bed sets
- [Soverom – Alt du trenger av interiør til soverommet - Kid](https://kid.no/soverom): Bedroom category featuring pillows, duvets, bed linens & accessories
- [Interiør – Interiør på nett - Kid](https://kid.no/interior): Interior decor category featuring spring collection & seasonal sale items
- [Møbler – Innredning til hjemmet - Kid](https://kid.no/mobler): Furniture category with chairs, tables, sofas & rugs at 30-50% off
- [Gardiner i mange lengder, farger og stiler - Kid](https://kid.no/gardiner): Curtains category with blackout, sheer & accessories from Camilla Pihl
- [Aktuelle kampanjer - Kid](https://kid.no/kampanjer): Current promotions & member offers on bedding, kitchenware & textiles
